privacy.meta_desc: How BlueCurve collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BlueCurve ("we", "our") takes the privacy of your data seriously. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights under the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).
privacy.s1_intro: When you use BlueCurve, we collect the following categories of data:
privacy.s1_item1: your email address and display name, provided at registration.
privacy.s1_item2: documents you upload to the platform (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) to create summaries, flashcards, or quizzes.
privacy.s1_item3: artefacts produced by the platform (summaries, flashcards, quizzes, chat history) associated with your account.
privacy.s1_item4: processing is fully delegated to Stripe. We never store card numbers or banking information directly.
privacy.s1_item5: token balance, transaction history, aggregated study statistics (number of sessions, modules viewed).
privacy.s1_item6: IP address, browser type, and access logs for security and debugging purposes.
privacy.s2_item1: Provide and maintain the BlueCurve service.
privacy.s2_item2: Create the study tools you request (summaries, flashcards, quizzes, chat responses).
privacy.s2_item3: Manage your subscription, token packs, and payments.
privacy.s2_item4: Send you transactional communications (payment confirmation, important service updates).
privacy.s2_item5: Detect and prevent abuse or violations of our terms of use.
privacy.s2_no_sell: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s3_intro: BlueCurve uses the following third-party services:
privacy.s3_item1: your files and chat messages are sent to an AI API to generate summaries, podcasts, flashcards, quizzes, and responses. This data is processed in accordance with the AI provider's privacy policy. We advise against uploading documents containing sensitive or confidential information.
privacy.s3_item2: secure processing of credit card payments and subscriptions. Stripe is PCI DSS certified.
privacy.s4_text: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, we will erase your personal data and uploaded files within a reasonable timeframe, unless legally required otherwise. Transaction data may be retained for accounting purposes in accordance with applicable law.
privacy.s5_intro: Under PIPEDA, you have the right to:
privacy.s5_item1: Access the personal information we hold about you.
privacy.s5_item3: Withdraw your consent to data processing.
privacy.s5_item4: Request deletion of your account and data.
privacy.s5_contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at
privacy.s6_text: BlueCurve uses session cookies and browser local storage solely for authentication and interface preferences (light / dark theme). We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
privacy.s7_text: We apply standard security measures (HTTPS transit encryption, secure authentication) to protect your data. No system is infallible; in the event of a breach, we will notify you within the timeframes required by law.
privacy.s8_text: We may update this policy at any time. In the event of a significant change, we will notify you by email or via an in-app notification. The date of last update is shown at the top of this page.
privacy.s9_text: For any questions regarding this policy or your personal data:

terms.meta_desc: The terms governing use of the BlueCurve platform.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms of use ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the BlueCurve platform. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these Terms in their entirety.
terms.s1_text: BlueCurve is a study-aid platform that allows students to create summaries, flashcards, explanatory audio tracks, and quizzes from their documents, access an exam library, and interact with a study assistant. The service is provided as-is and may evolve without notice.
terms.s2_item1: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and all activity carried out from your account.
terms.s2_item2: You must provide accurate information at registration.
terms.s2_item3: Only one account per person is permitted.
terms.s2_item4: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. Users between 13 and 16 must have obtained parental or legal guardian consent.
terms.s3_item1: Use the service for illegal purposes or in violation of these Terms.
terms.s3_item2: Upload copyrighted content without authorization, or hateful, unlawful content, or content that infringes the privacy of third parties.
terms.s3_item3: Attempt to circumvent security mechanisms or access data belonging to other users.
terms.s3_item4: Automate access to the service (scraping, bots) without written authorization.
terms.s3_item5: Resell or redistribute access to the service to third parties.
terms.s3_item6: Create multiple accounts to circumvent free plan limitations.
terms.s4_text1: You retain full ownership of the documents you upload. By depositing them on BlueCurve, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to process them solely for the purpose of providing you with the service.
terms.s4_text2: You are solely responsible for the content you upload and warrant that you have the necessary rights to share it with the service.
terms.s5_text: BlueCurve and all its components (interface, brand, code, artefacts generated by the platform itself) are the exclusive property of BlueCurve. No element may be reproduced, copied, or distributed without our prior written consent.
terms.s6_item1: purchased tokens have no expiry date but are non-refundable once bought.
terms.s6_item2: the subscription renews automatically (monthly or annual) and can be cancelled at any time from your settings. No refund is granted for the current period.
terms.s6_item3: access to an exam (1 token) or a solution (2 tokens) is permanent: once unlocked, it remains accessible indefinitely, even after a Pro subscription ends.
terms.s6_item4: All prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD) and do not include applicable taxes.
terms.s6_item5: Payments are processed securely by Stripe.
terms.s7_text: We make every effort to keep the service available, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability. Maintenance outages or technical incidents may occur. BlueCurve cannot be held liable for losses related to a temporary unavailability.
terms.s8_text1: Content generated by BlueCurve (summaries, flashcards, quizzes, chat responses) is produced by an automated system. It may contain errors or inaccuracies. BlueCurve does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of this content for any specific academic use.
terms.s8_text2: To the fullest extent permitted by law, our total liability cannot exceed the amount you have paid in the last 12 months.
terms.s9_text: You may delete your account at any time from your settings. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate an account in the event of a violation of these Terms, without notice and without refund.
